mapper.update: UPDATE ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base SET order_status = 6, order_last_return_time = #{orderLastReturnTime}, order_finished_time = now() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

UPDATE ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base SET order_status = 7, order_finished_time = now(), order_cancel_date = now() WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, order_create_time, now()) >= #{minutes} and order_status = 1

UPDATE ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return set
return_state = #{param.returnState},
expiration_time = #{param.expirationTime},
call_status = #{param.callStatus},
resubmissions_number = #{param.resubmissionsNumber},
historical_return_status = #{param.historicalReturnStatus},
return_number = #{param.returnNumber},
return_real_name = #{param.returnRealName},
return_addr_id = #{param.returnAddrId},
return_addr = #{param.returnAddr},
return_addr_name = #{param.returnAddr},
return_shop_handle = #{param.returnShopHandle},
return_shop_message = #{param.returnShopMessage},
return_shop_time = #{param.returnShopTime},
revoke_num = #{param.revokeNum},
close_time = #{param.closeTime},
fill_logistics_time = #{param.fillLogisticsTime},
return_shipping_code = #{param.returnShippingCode},
return_finish_time = #{param.returnFinishTime},
return_mobile = #{param.returnMobile},
return_post_code = #{param.returnPostCode},
order_operator = #{param.orderOperator},
order_operator_time = now() WHERE return_code = #{param.returnCode}
mapper.delete: delete from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_plus_order where TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, creat_time, now()) >= #{minutes} and is_pay = 0
update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_payment_vocher set review_status = 3, review_time = now() where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.buyer_user_id, b.order_id, b.order_shipping_code, e.express_pinyin FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base b LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_express e ON b.order_shipping_express_id = e.express_id WHERE b.order_status = '4' AND order_receiver_date < NOW()

SELECT order_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, order_create_time, now()) >= #{minutes} and order_status = 1 and payment_code = 1) or (TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, order_create_time, now()) >= 4320 and order_status = 1 and payment_code = 2)
SELECT goods_id, common_id, order_goods_num AS goodsNum FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT gb.goods_id, gb.goods_salenum, gc.common_salenum FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gb.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE gb.goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT payment_number, redpacket_code, order_id, voucher_code, payment_code FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, order_create_time, now()) >= #{minutes} and order_status = 1

SELECT oor.order_id, oor.return_cash, oor.return_code, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oob.order_id = oor.order_id WHERE oor.return_state = 1 AND oor.return_type = 1 AND order_status = 6 AND HOUR( TIMEDIFF(now() , return_add_time)) >= 24 AND return_add_time > '2019-08-01'

select oob.order_id, oob.order_from, oob.pay_code, oob.payment_other_number, oor.return_code, sb.supplier_shop_id as shopId, sb.shop_type as shopType from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob, ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = oor.shop_id where oob.order_id = oor.order_id and oob.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT oor.order_id, oor.return_cash, oor.return_code, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_status FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oob.order_id = oor.order_id WHERE oor.return_state = 1 AND oor.return_type = 2 AND order_status = 6 AND HOUR( TIMEDIFF(now() , return_add_time)) >= 24 AND return_add_time > '2019-08-01'

select oor.order_id, oor.return_cash, oor.return_code, oor.return_state, oor.return_add_time, oob.buyer_user_name, oob.order_status from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob on oob.order_id = oor.order_id where oor.return_state = 1 and oor.return_type = 1 AND (order_status = 3 or (order_status = 4 and virtual_goods = 0 )) and HOUR(TIMEDIFF(now(), return_add_time)) >= 24
select order_id from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where order_status = 1 and now() >= seckill_cancel_time

SELECT oog.goods_id, oog.common_id, oog.order_goods_num, gc.common_salenum, oob.order_promotion_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oog.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on oog.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE oog.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return set return_shop_handle =#{returnShopHandle}, return_state=#{returnState}, return_shop_message=#{returnShopMessage}, return_shop_time=#{returnShopTime}, return_finish_time =#{returnFinishTime} where return_code = #{returnCode}

update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission set order_status = 6 where order_id in
#{item}
